module: Small container of typed "custom fields" (string, number, boolean, vec3, quat) and sorted tags, with serialization. The module returns a constructor: each call creates an independent object. Useful for attaching free-form data to a gameplay object while saving it as JSON.
usage:
local cf = require("gameplay/util/customFields")()
cf:add("difficulte", "number", 3)
cf:addTag("ville")
local valeur, type, existe = cf:get("difficulte")
notes: Types handled on deserialization: string, number, boolean, vec3, quat; a field of any other type is ignored.
validate() converts strings: '', '0', 0 and 'false' give false for a boolean; vec3 and quat accept 'x,y,z' / 'x,y,z,w' (comma-separated), otherwise a null value.

add(), set(), remove() and has() test `self.values[name]`: a boolean field equal to false is therefore considered nonexistent (set() refuses to modify it, add() accepts re-adding it and then duplicates its name in names).
A special field named "tags" triggers updateTags() on add or modification.
get() returns (value, type, true) or (nil, nil, false).
addTag() returns false if the tag already exists but returns nothing (nil) on success.

C.desc: Object returned by the module constructor. Fields: names (field order), types, values, tags (set) and sortedTags (sorted list).

init.desc: Initializes the names, types, values, tags and sortedTags tables.

onSerialize.desc: Returns {names, types, values, tags}; vec3 and quat are converted to tables.

onDeserialized.desc: Recreates all fields and tags from the serialized data (clears the existing state).

validate.desc: Converts a value to the requested type (string, number, boolean, vec3, quat).

returns.desc: Converted value; nil if the type is unknown.

set.desc: Changes the value of an existing field (without type validation).

returns.desc: false if the field does not exist.

addTag.desc: Adds a tag and re-sorts the list.

returns.desc: false if absent or already present, nil otherwise.

removeTag.desc: Removes a tag, designated by its name or its index in sortedTags.

returns.desc: false if the tag does not exist.
false if the field does not exist.

add.desc: Adds a typed field; the value is validated according to the type.

datatype.desc: string, number, boolean, vec3 or quat.

returns.desc: false if the name already exists.

updateTags.desc: Rebuilds sortedTags (tags sorted alphabetically) from tags.
